title: Janhit Abhiyan v. Union of India (EWS Case)

content.caseIdentity: Janhit Abhiyan v. Union of India (EWS Case), (2022) 10 SCC 1
content.holding: Upheld 103rd Amendment (10% EWS reservation); economic criteria alone can form a valid basis for affirmative action; 50% limit applies only to 15(4)/16(4) quotas.
content.relevance: Validation of Economic Weaker Section reservations.

evidence.note: 5-Judge Constitution Bench judgment in Writ Petition (Civil) No. 55 of 2019; 2022 INSC 1172; (2022) 10 SCC 1.
